goal: Deprecate encryptwallet RPC behind a configuration flag
Prevent fund loss and key exposure caused by encrypting wallets after creation
agreement: Strong support with multiple ACKs and no open objections
Support because creating a new encrypted wallet is cleaner and safer (pablomartin4btc)
Concept approval without stated reasons (pseudoramdom, rkrux)
Full approval on latest push with all test feedback resolved (achow101, w0xlt, pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it mitigates severe fund-loss risks from invalidated backups and altered descriptor conditions
It phases out leaving plaintext keys on storage and unblocks full removal of post-creation encryption
